step1.title: Know where you stand
step1.description: Set up your profile in a few minutes and choose the reason you want to keep in mind.

step2.title: Move forward one day at a time
step2.description: Track your smoke-free days and find small tools to sustain your decision.

step3.title: Recognize what you're building
step3.description: See your consistency clearly and celebrate every milestone without comparing yourself to anyone.

clarity.title: More clarity
clarity.description: A simple record helps you see your process, even on difficult days.

support.title: More support
support.description: Reminders and resources designed to accompany you, not judge you.

confidence.title: More confidence
confidence.description: Every day you choose to take care of yourself becomes a sign of progress.

hero.eyebrow: A space to choose yourself again
hero.description: No Smoking helps you turn an important decision into small, visible, possible steps. No guilt. No pressure. At your own pace.
hero.imageAlt: Preview of the progress dashboard inside the No Smoking app
hero.proof: This is what your progress looks like, straight from the app.

howItWorks.eyebrow: A process that fits your life
howItWorks.title: A gentle path to begin
howItWorks.description: The tool adapts to your decision: it gives you context, tracking, and encouragement to keep moving forward.

system.eyebrow: A simple map to get started
system.title: Three ideas to understand the journey

life.title: One life
life.description: Your life represents the margin of care you're building; every decision counts, without turning the process into a judgment.

cigarette.title: Log a cigarette
cigarette.description: When you smoke, you log that cigarette with the button so the cycle stays visible and you can understand your progress.

positiveActions.title: Add positive actions
positiveActions.description: You can also add positive actions: small decisions that help you sustain your journey.

benefitsSection.title: Your effort deserves a place to grow.

progress.title: An example of progress
progress.description: Numbers can help you recognize what you're already doing. This example is illustrative: your process will always be yours.
progress.cycleDescription: Each logged cigarette adds one to the cycle. When you reach the fifth logged cigarette, you lose a life and the cigarette cycle resets.

achievementsSection.title: A map of recognitions you're building
achievementsSection.description: These milestones are an invitation to recognize your consistency, not a promise of perfection. They are a public illustrative preview; they don't indicate unlocked achievements.

finalCta.title: Today counts too.
finalCta.description: Start with a kind decision toward yourself. The rest can be built step by step.
